body: Please provide a simple Maven reproducer. Thanks.

issue.title: Include in the "Feedback provided" category issues which *used* to have a "triage/needs-reproducer" label

repository.name: quarkus-github-lottery
repository.description: A Quarkus-powered application that regularly sends short lists of GitHub issues for triagers/maintainers to consider

issue.body:
See for example https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/issues/29253 : a reproducer was provided, after which we removed the "triage/needs-reproducer" label, resulting in that issue no longer being reported through the lottery...

We should probably include in the "Feedback provided" category issues which *used* to have a "triage/needs-reproducer" label, even if they don't have it anymore.

I'm not sure how easy this will be to implement, however. Unless there's an efficient way to query the history through GitHub APIs (GraphQL?), I don't think it will be feasible.
